title: Two Operating Systems

world_class_taste_gate.freshness: PASS. The route avoids a plain zodiac compatibility poster by making the fresh turn about pace: he does not slow her down, and she does not ruin the plan; together they turn planning into lived life.
world_class_taste_gate.ownability: PASS. The Aachu/Zuv proof beats are specific to the channel: calm planning, expressive starting, screenshots, instinct, silent worry, loud feeling, and affectionate choosing.
world_class_taste_gate.physically_staged: PASS. The route can be staged through notebook, screenshots, keys, door movement, hand gestures, body distance, eye-line, and a final shared frame.
world_class_taste_gate.non_obvious_turn: PASS. The expected zodiac trope is opposites attract; the repaired turn is that the planner becomes a runway and the starter becomes the ignition.
world_class_taste_gate.cold_viewer_send_reason: PASS. Planner/impulse couples have an immediate tag behavior: 'this is you' / 'this is me.'
world_class_taste_gate.recent_lane_avoidance: PASS. It avoids food denial, subtitles/private captions, generic domestic repairs, ordinary errands, and overthinking/reassurance.

risk_notes: Do not use literal zodiac symbols as the main visual mechanic.
Do not let the slide 7 'chaos' line become a repeat of prior chaos/home packages.
Do not generate static side-by-side couple portraits; every slide needs action.
